about: Rules every public line must pass. The build holds any file that breaks one.

framing.about: Positive framing: describe decisions and outcomes. Add your own patterns (regular expressions).

banned_phrases.why: Negative framing; describe what you moved on to
Empty superlative; say what you did

denylist_about: Names that must never appear publicly: private repos, internal project or client names, tools you don't want named, file paths. Matching ignores case, spaces, dashes, underscores, and line breaks.

voice.about: plain = no colons, semicolons, or arrows in public lines (they read as machine-written). Set false to turn off.
